Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Novex is ready to start a standard MSA + Order Form conversation. A few priorities from our side to flag up front so legal can prioritize review: 

- Usage caps: we expect a bursty production profile, can you confirm whether Redwood supports soft caps + overage pricing on the order form?
- Data residency: core product data must remain in us-west and us-east regions; can we capture the deployment region in the Order Form?
- Signer routing: procurement signs (Jane Roberts, CFO), but legal will countersign; need signer map if there are different exhibit approvers.
- SOC2 evidence: we’ll request SOC2 Type II report and encryption-at-rest details during contract review.

I attached a short party sheet with billing contacts and our procurement timelines. We’d like to have a redline pass within 7 business days if possible.

Best,
Meghan Turner
Director, Procurement
Novex Data

- Signer routing: please confirm final signer names & emails on the party sheet — we’ll return a signer map template for your CFO and legal.
- SOC2: Jonas will share the link to our SOC2 report and a short summary of encryption controls.

1) Kimberly to do a first-pass intake and upload a redline of our standard MSA (target: EOD Thu, 2027-10-07).
2) Jonas to post SOC2/controls evidence to the shared Drive.
3) Meghan to confirm signers and any special billing PO requirements.

If that works I’ll kick off the redline now.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
